I strongly advise others to think twice before choosing this hospital.

I recently got my wife’s kidney stone laser surgery done at Suchak Hospital, Malad East (just a 2-minute walk from the local railway station), and I am truly grateful to Mrs. Abha Anil Suchak (CEO & Managing Director), her son Dr. Suraj Suchak (MBBS, MS – General Surgery, MCh – Urology, Urologist, Andrologist), and their entire team.

We rushed to the hospital at 3:00 AM in an emergency situation, and even at that hour, the response was extremely prompt and professional. The admission and evaluation process was smooth and well-coordinated.

Dr. Suraj Suchak – a true human organ saver warrior – successfully removed a 15 mm kidney stone and, most importantly, saved my wife’s kidney. The stone was removed through advanced laser surgery without any external body cut, which made the procedure minimally invasive and helped in faster recovery. He is an expert urologist and laparoscopic surgeon with over 20 years of experience, and it clearly reflects in the way he handles patients—with confidence, clarity, and genuine compassion. He explained the condition and treatment plan in a very reassuring manner, which gave us a lot of confidence.

In just a few hours, the team completed all the necessary clinical investigations such as sonography and CT scan, confirmed the diagnosis, and performed the surgery. The entire procedure went smoothly, and my wife is now recovering well.

My heartfelt thanks to Mrs. Abha Anil Suchak, Dr. Suraj Suchak, Dr. Komal, and the entire Suchak Hospital team. Everyone—from doctors to nursing staff to support staff—was polite, helpful, and attentive at every step.

I would also like to mention Dr. Komal Ma’am, who was extremely supportive and encouraging throughout the process. She gave me a lot of courage regarding the surgery and helped ease my anxiety. I sincerely wish her great success in her medical career and pray that she continues to grow as an excellent doctor in her field.

From the bottom of my heart, I pray that Allah Subhanahu Wa Ta’ala blesses Suchak Hospital, Mrs. Abha Anil Suchak, Dr. Suraj Suchak, Dr. Komal, and their entire team. May He grant them more success, advanced medical facilities, and the strength to continue saving human lives and serving patients with the same dedication, honesty, and kindness. 🌹🙏

I highly recommend Suchak Hospital and Dr. Suraj Suchak to anyone suffering from kidney stones, any type of health issue, or urological problem.
